comments: Chosen assumptions: ego makes a scripted right lateral evasion after 2 s at 10-11 m/s toward the rear quarter of agent1, which starts 12-14 m ahead in the target lane at 8-9 m/s. Agent1 responds with continued lane and speed holding. The interaction is with the leading target-lane car, rather than a target-lane follower. Ego initiates; both partners are same-direction cars on one trafficway. Seven-second horizon; no collision is required.
